blocks.heading: SEO & GEO that gets you found *on Google and in AI answers*
blocks.lead: Search engine optimisation and generative engine optimisation for growing businesses — so customers find you whether they search on Google or ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity.

header.title: Search visibility, *old and new*
header.subtitle: Classic SEO still drives most traffic. GEO makes sure AI assistants know, trust, and cite your business too.

items.title: Technical SEO
items.body: Site speed, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, redirects, and sitemaps — the foundation every ranking depends on.

items.title: On-Page & Content SEO
items.body: Keyword research, page optimisation, and helpful content that answers what your customers are actually searching for.

items.title: Local SEO
items.body: Google Business Profile optimisation, local citations, and reviews strategy so you show up in the map pack where you work.

items.title: Generative Engine Optimisation
items.body: Clear, well-structured, citable content and brand signals that help AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity recommend you.

items.title: Structured Data & Entity SEO
items.body: Schema markup and consistent business information so search engines and AI models understand exactly who you are.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Monthly reports on rankings, organic traffic, leads, and AI-search visibility — in plain language, tied to business results.

header.title: How we *grow your visibility*
header.subtitle: SEO compounds over time. We start with the fixes that matter most and build from there.

items.title: Audit
items.body: A technical, content, and competitor audit of your site, plus a check of how AI assistants describe your business today.

items.title: Strategy
items.body: A prioritised plan of keywords, pages, and fixes, focused on the searches that bring you customers.

items.title: Optimise & Create
items.body: We fix technical issues, optimise key pages, publish new content, and strengthen your local and brand signals.

items.title: Measure & Refine
items.body: Monthly reporting on rankings, traffic, and leads, with the next month’s priorities based on what the data shows.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.body: Content, social, and email to grow your brand

blocks.heading: Ready to *get found?*
blocks.body: Get a free SEO & GEO audit. We'll show you what's holding your site back on Google and in AI search, and what to fix first.

seo.metaDescription: SEO and generative engine optimisation (GEO) for growing businesses: technical SEO, content, local SEO and AI-search visibility. Get a free SEO audit.
